## Purpose

`coreai` is the Rust binding and model-kit crate for Apple's Core AI runtime (`.aimodel`) — the 1:1 counterpart of [`coremlit`](https://github.com/findit-studio/coremlit), which plays the same role for CoreML. It is meant to expose the same kit vocabulary (a safe runtime core, plus opt-in feature-gated model kits), with the concrete backend a downstream consumer (for example `mediagraph`) selects by feature.

## Platform

Apple's Core AI runtime is only available on **macOS 27+** and **iOS 27+**. This crate targets Apple platforms only.

## Status

**0.0.0 — the name is reserved on crates.io. No API is implemented yet.**

## Roadmap

- Safe runtime core over Apple's Core AI (`.aimodel`) APIs.
- A kit lineup mirroring `coremlit`'s (speech, embeddings, and related on-device pipelines), landing as the Core AI runtime itself ships on macOS 27 / iOS 27.
- A `coreai-torch` export path, echoing `coremlit`'s CoreML conversion pipeline.

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
coreai = "0.0.0"
```
